poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE PULSE OF THE MUSIC IS ALL THAT MATTERS NOW. NO WORDS, ONLY RHYTHM.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: LOST IN THE SPARKLE AND THE DEEP END. A TEMPORARY, GLAMOROUS DISCONNECTION.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS NIGHT BELONGS TO THE DANCE FLOOR'S ECHOES
sonnetLines: The signal breaks against the glass,
A humming rhythm starts to rise.
We lose ourselves where shadows pass,
No need for words or careful plea,
Just motion caught in amber light.
Into the depth of pure delight.
Let calls ring out and fade away,
The heart is left where rhythm reigns,
Beyond the reach of telephone chains.
